# betterado_workitemquery_permissions (Resource)

Manages work item query ACL permissions in Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_project" "example" {
  name               = "Example Project"
  description        = "Managed by Terraform"
  visibility         = "private"
  version_control    = "Git"
  work_item_template = "Agile"
}

data "betterado_group" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "[Example Project]\\Readers"
}

resource "betterado_workitemquery_permissions" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  path       = "/"
  principal  = data.betterado_group.example.descriptor
  replace    = false

  permissions = {
    Read            = "allow"
    Write           = "deny"
    Delete          = "deny"
    ManagePermissions = "deny"
    Contribute      = "deny"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Map of String)
- `principal` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `path` (String)
